Hi Olivia —

Thanks for the clear ask. We can provide the full itemized ledger as a CSV and a short explainer doc. I've attached a small sample CSV (prodx_token_export_sample.csv) so you can confirm the columns before we run the full export. The export includes: date (UTC), model_id, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, per_token_rate_cents, line_item_id, invoice_period_start, invoice_period_end, commit_tier_applied, and invoice_id.

Summary answers to your discount questions (short version):
- Commit tiers: discounts are applied on a per-billing-period basis. Each commit tier has a per-token rate band.
- Reaching a higher tier within the same invoice period does NOT retroactively change prior line items; usage that falls into each band is billed at the band's rate (tiered/banded pricing). We also offer an alternate blended-trueup option for enterprise customers if you prefer a single blended rate for reporting (requires amendment).
- Overages: charged at the next tier's overage rate for the remainder of the bill period; any committed shortfall at month-end is billed as true-up according to the contract schedule.
- Mid-period commits or amendments: we pro-rate the committed capacity and apply the appropriate banding for the remainder of the invoice period.

To proceed, please confirm: 1) full date range you want exported (CSV), 2) whether you want per-request IDs included, and 3) whether you want the blended-trueup option documented (I've included the current standard approach above). Once confirmed I'll run the full export to the secure Drive link and share a downloadable CSV.

We're happy to include a sample calc row in the CSV showing the rate math.

Deal reference: PX-2026-1110. I've looped in Rishi for pricing nuance and Lauren for billing CSV format.
